normalize_tensor_image: normalize a tensor image with mean and standard deviation per channel
resize_numpy_image: resize a numpy image to a specified size with bilinear interpolation
check_is_tensor_image: check if an input is a 3-dimensional torch tensor image
check_is_numpy_image: check if an input is a 2D or 3D numpy array image
resize_with_interpolation: resize a numpy image to exact dimensions with nearest, bilinear, or bicubic interpolation
